_comment: Copies of a blocked site that would otherwise get round the block. Data, not code: edit this file, not mirrors.js. bySite: blocking the key also blocks these domains (and their subdomains). translateGoog: also block the site through Google Translate's proxy (youtube-com.translate.goog and its www-/m- forms). archives: also block a blocked site's pages inside these archives (web.archive.org/web/<date>/<site>/...). The Invidious list is the public instances known on 19 Nov 2026; instances come and go, so refresh it with each Web Guard release.
